description: Deterministic Phase F1 evaluation of the controlled FORMA-Bench coverage worlds.
honest_evidence_assumption: Trusted attestation and public certificates use the benchmark's honest-attestor and honest-certificate fill: the attested or certified value is the declared world value. This is an assumption, not an adversarial robustness result.

tactic_costs.message: honest attestation of each sensitive attribute
tactic_costs.note: The attestor principal is already on the generated plan. The tactic records reliance on that principal and does not insert a second one. Trusted attestation and public certificates use the benchmark's honest-attestor and honest-certificate fill: the attested or certified value is the declared world value. This is an assumption, not an adversarial robustness result.

tactic_costs.message: selective disclosure of each sensitive attribute to the named checker
tactic_costs.note: Selective disclosure reveals the fixture value to the named checker. No attestor is added.

tactic_costs.message: honest public certificate of each sensitive attribute
tactic_costs.note: The attestor principal is already on the generated plan. The tactic records reliance on that principal and does not insert a second one. Trusted attestation and public certificates use the benchmark's honest-attestor and honest-certificate fill: the attested or certified value is the declared world value. This is an assumption, not an adversarial robustness result.
No new role or connector is inserted. Architect escalation adds an approval record and no evidence.
